wants.topic: Miracle stories of saints (Neem Karoli Baba)
wants.evidence: Anant Gatha's top performing videos are exclusively about Neem Karoli Baba, showing massive vsNormal scores (up to 41.86).
GuruVaani Studio's top videos feature Maa Durga intervening in the lives of common people (e.g., 'Maa Durga helping Sugandha'), achieving extreme vsNormal scores (316.79).
Mystery of the World's high performance on obscure topics like Rishi Markandeya and Ahilya's story suggests a hunger for deep-lore rather than mainstream epics.
Rasiya Films and Anant Gatha both show high engagement on 'Full Movie' formats of Ramayana, indicating the audience prefers long-form narrative consumption.

gaps: Lack of high-quality, long-form content on the specific life lessons of minor Puranic characters.
Viewers often ask for 'Part 2' in comments, suggesting a gap in serialized content that maintains narrative continuity.
A shortage of authentic historical context mixed with mythology; viewers show interest in 'Real History' but often get generic storytelling.
saturated: Generic 'Kaliya Mardan' or standard Krishna childhood stories which have become commoditized.
Short-form motivation reels or standard 'Shorts' that lack deep narrative substance.
Over-dramatized thumbnails for basic Navratri stories that are now being ignored by the audience (as seen in weak performance of some Navratri-themed videos).
title_patterns: Using emotional triggers like 'अद्भुत कथा' (Amazing story) or 'रहस्य' (Secret/Mystery).
High-stakes conflict framing: 'Maa Durga vs [Demon/Villain]' or 'Why did [Character] do [Shocking Act]?'
Combining high-authority figures with common struggles: 'Maa Durga helping a poor devotee'.
Explicitly labeling content as 'Full Movie' or '4K Ultra HD' to signal production value.
